messages:
mona: Nightly eval flagged 18 failures in q8-nightly for fncall schema checks. Most failing field: "actions" emitted as string or object instead of an array. Example from logs:

mona: eval-bot snippet:
```
{"tool":"plan_executor","function_call":{"name":"execute_actions","arguments":{"actions":"[{\"op\":\"click\",\"target\":\"#buy\"}]"}}}
```

ryan: :eyes: stringified-array again. Also saw numeric-key object case:
```
{"arguments":{"actions":{"0":{"op":"type","text":"hello"},"1":{"op":"submit"}}}}
```

alex: Numeric keys usually mean a list got coerced to a dict at some layer. Could be streaming assembler or a serializer on reassembly.

mona: Failures only on q8 quant build, fp16 unaffected. Token diffs show extra escapes and stray backslashes in completions.

sophie: I repro locally if streaming=true. stream=false yields correct functioncall payload.

ryan: Repro is streaming + batch. Single request streaming ok, batch streaming breaks.

mona: Links: nightly job https://ci.redwood/queues/nightly/198888/summary and reproducer gist https://gist.github.com/r/quant-actions-repro

alex: Quick mitigation:
1) Schema sanitizer: coerce numeric-keyed dicts into arrays when keys are contiguous 0..n-1.
2) Fallback: if "actions" is a string starting with '[' try json.loads.
3) Instrument streaming reassembly in quant runtime to capture chunk boundaries and escaping.

sophie: I'll draft a small PR with 1+2 to stop noisy alerts.

ryan: Adding instrumentation to quant runtime now. Found chunk split that leaves a backslash at boundary, causing double-escaping when aggregator joins chunks.

mona: Eval-bot: nightly q8-2026-03: 18 fails -> 14 schema mismatches, 4 flaky retriable. CI ticket #QN-502 opened.

alex: Triage owners: @sophie implement sanitizer hotfix, @ryan debug assembler, @alex review runtime traces.

sophie: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/serving/pull/4855 includes sanitizer and tests. Short unit tests added.

ryan: Pushed instrumentation traces to gist; confirmed assembler splits on multi-byte sequences in the quant encoder. Working on fix to ensure chunk reassembly respects utf-8 boundaries.

mona: We'll mute duplicate alerts for the same payload tokens until the hotfix lands. Re-run nightly after merge.

sophie: Merged hotfix after CI green. Will monitor tomorrow's run.

ryan: Added regression test in nightly harness to run the streaming batch reproducer on every quant PR.

mona: Thanks — dropping follow-ups into the CI ticket. If you see other odd key prefixes (e.g., "item0" or "_0") paste examples here. :thumbsup:
